caption: The drawing features a horizontal rectangular band positioned centrally on a blank off-white background. The band is decorated with a repeating pattern that primarily uses shades of green, gold, brown, and yellow. The upper edge of the band has three horizontal stripes in gold, brown, and yellow. Below this, there is a repeating motif composed of a stylized, symmetrical golden shape resembling a flower or mushroom cap, with three small yellow dots at the bottom, and a brown base outlined in gold, spaced evenly along the length of the band. Hanging vertically between each main motif is a lighter green drop-like shape. At the bottom of each main motif, there is a green circle with a yellow dot in the center and a thin brown ring surrounding it. The lower edge of the band is bordered by a thin yellow stripe and a green line. The space outside of this decorated band is unadorned and plain.
title: Wallpaper Border
